patch.value: Routing model: PM_SLACK_ROUTES JSON map + per-event channel override

Routing is an optional JSON env PM_SLACK_ROUTES mapping a selector (event name like 'block', or type like 'type:Bug', or 'status:blocked') to {webhook?,channel?}. First matching rule wins; falls back to PM_SLACK_WEBHOOK/PM_SLACK_CHANNEL. Keeps zero-config default identical. Pure function selectRoute() unit-tested.
Implemented as designed: PM_SLACK_ROUTES JSON array, first-match-wins, selector forms event/type:/status:/wildcard, fallback to PM_SLACK_WEBHOOK/CHANNEL. Zero-config default unchanged.
